description: Dependency-free game networking transports: a pluggable connection/transport API, reliable UDP via an embedded KCP, an in-process local transport, and span-based message buffers.
The runtime of the Prowl game engine: scenes, GameObjects and components, rendering, physics, audio, animation, navigation, input and VR, usable from any .NET application without the editor.
Viewer and render profiler UI for Graphite debugger recordings.
Editor and import time tools for Prowl.Graphite.Rendering: LOD chains and impostors.

An MCUmgr client for .NET: the SMP protocol, the command groups Zephyr serves, firmware update for MCUboot, and serial, UDP, and Bluetooth Low Energy transports. Bluetooth is for Android, iOS, macOS and Windows.

Translates list filters written in the AIP-160 syntax (google.aip.dev/160) into CEL expressions of a Great.Parts.Cel environment and compiles them: errors with their place in the filter, evaluation on each item, the CEL tree for your own translation, Native AOT without reflection.

CEL Policy for Great.Parts.Cel: read a policy in YAML (rules with variables, conditions, outputs, nested rules, first-match and aggregate semantics) and compile it in a CEL environment into one program, with every error at its line and column in the document.

Dependency injection for Great.Parts.Cel: register CEL environments, a compilation cache and a replaceable evaluator in Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection, and validate options with CEL expressions.
ASP.NET Core support for Great.Parts.Cel: CEL expressions in authorization policies and in the validation of requests of minimal API endpoints.
Crystal-Reports-class report engine: JSON report definition + data -> HTML/PDF. Native Rust core.
Official typed Alkax developer API client for .NET.

Build financial contributions (GitHub Sponsors, Open Collective) directly into your .NET app: check what the current user contributes, open a checkout, and nag politely. No account, no keys, no setup.
自研轻量 Modbus TCP 协议栈与点位映射服务，零第三方协议依赖，支持 net8.0 / net10.0。
